notes.title: A couple of news about DLC and a new game in the Feed the Pets franchise
notes.content:
[h1]Hey! Long time no see![/h1]
It's been a long time since the game was released. More than two years have passed since the game Feed the Pets and its DLC Feed the Pets Autumn pack of animal were released.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33548958/23590df96a5dec5a234095bdd10412636007605c.png[/img]
[i]Autumn pack of animal is a fall-themed add-on released in honor of the Steam fall sale, it included 8 new characters.[/i]

[h2]The first news: [/h2]
[h3]The Autumn pack of animal add-on will soon be unavailable in the Steam store.[/h3]
But don't get upset! I will try to do everything so that it does not turn out very negatively for its owners.

[h2]The second news: [/h2]
[h3]Soon there will be an announcement of a new game in the Feed the Pets franchise.[/h3]
It is worth noting that the main characters in this game will already be all the favorite characters of the Feed the Pets Autumn pack of animal DLC.

[h2]But it will be a new game. Literally.[/h2]
[h3]The game was created from scratch, and the character animations were also redesigned[/h3]
It is not always possible to fully implement your idea the first time.
So in the case of Feed the Pets, the game turned out to be slightly unfinished, with many bugs and other shortcomings.

In the new game, called Feed the Pass Fail Animals, I tried to fix most of the problems of the original game. The new architecture allows for a more flexible approach to game development, which will help make it much better.

Follow the development of the new game in [url=https://twitter.com/Volrest]Twitter [/url], immediately after the publication of the page in the store, there will be news about the game.

I hope for your support!
Sincerely, Volrest

notes.title: Screen resolution & translate fix
notes.content:
[h2]Thanks to one good girl, I found out about a problem with different screen resolutions.[/h2]

The problem was that on the small screens there was no visible price to buy an improvement

[img]https://sun9-5.userapi.com/c200628/v200628202/2e191/ax6cNHeXv7o.jpg[/img]

Now I solved it and now all the interface elements are displayed correctly on all screens!

[img]https://sun9-4.userapi.com/c200628/v200628202/2e180/cnrUCUeVOS0.jpg[/img]

[h1]Changelog:[/h1]
[b]FIXED:[/b]
[list]
[*] Problem with resolutions
[*] Bad translate for some sentence
[*] Bug with unable to achieve Manager achievement
[/list]

Thank you, good girl!

We appreciate your feedback!
